title: 5 Rules of Sub-Second Web Performance
subtitle: How to Hit 100/100 Core Web Vitals

slides.heading: Rule 1: Convert to WebP & AVIF
slides.text: Never serve legacy PNGs or JPEGs for web assets. Modern WebP reduces file size by 80-90% with zero perceptible loss in visual fidelity.

slides.heading: Rule 2: Asynchronous Fonts
slides.text: Synchronous web fonts block screen rendering for up to 800ms. Load fonts with preloading and print media swaps to achieve instant First Contentful Paint.

slides.heading: Rule 3: Zero Layout Shifts (CLS)
slides.text: Always specify explicit width, height, and aspect-ratio attributes on every image container so browsers reserve layout boundaries before media loads.

slides.heading: Rule 4: Avoid Hiding Above-The-Fold
slides.text: Never set initial opacity to 0 with JavaScript on hero titles or hero imagery. Animate position and scale, but keep the initial paint immediate.

slides.heading: Rule 5: Benchmark & Iterate
slides.text: Audit continuously with Lighthouse and Core Web Vitals to deliver a lightning-fast experience to every visitor on any network.
